name: Sperman ~Sono Fukushuu no Maku o Yabure!!~
original_name: スペルマン ～その復讐の膜を破れ!!～
source: Men and women have fought for supremacy lots of years, in the end the women won the war and over time start treating men as slaves. However, a resistance started and through strange experiments the protagonist acquired cat ears, tail and a body whose fluids act as aphrodisiacs! With all these weapons Spelman enters a elite all-girls school to turn carefully chosen targets into his sex slaves in order to make men supreme once again. Will Spelman achieve his goal?
translation: 男人和女人为了霸权斗争了很多年，最终女人赢得了战争，随着时间的推移，开始把男人当作奴隶。然而，反抗开始了，通过奇怪的实验，主角获得了猫耳、尾巴和具有春药作用的身体！带着所有这些武器，斯佩尔曼进入了一所精英女子学校，将精心挑选的目标变成他的性奴隶，以便再次让男人至高无上。斯佩尔曼会实现他的目标吗？
